generate_codeowners: run mkowners.py to generate a .github/CODEOWNERS file from OWNERS files in the git repository
parse_owners_file: parse an OWNERS file and return an Owners namedtuple with parent, directives, and directory fields
expand_directives: expand OWNERS directives into a mapping of glob patterns to their assigned owners
add_parent_to_globs: recursively add parent OWNERS file owners to child directory glob patterns
git_glob_files: use git ls-files to find all files matching a glob pattern in the repository
